# Leos Trading FZE

> Leos Trading FZE is a UAE-based supplier of OEM, aftermarket, obsolete and hard-to-find spare parts for trucks, construction equipment, generators, marine, oilfield and industrial applications. It also sources new and used machinery, trucks and forklifts, and exports worldwide from the UAE. Registered office at Block C, VL02-155, SRTIP, Sharjah, United Arab Emirates; office at 612 Al Kaabi, Al Nahda 1, Dubai, UAE. Quotations by request (RFQ): trade@leosdubai.com, +971 50 848 9640 (WhatsApp).

Leos Trading is an independent supplier and is not an authorized distributor of any listed brand unless stated otherwise. Brand names are trademarks of their owners.
